name: careened_hull
notes: A two-masted sea-going ship, 22 metres from stem to taffrail and 6 in the beam, lying on the salt heeled fifty degrees onto her starboard side: bow to local -Z, deck turned to +X with the lower masts still standing out over the pan, barnacle crust over the bilge and her anchor on its chain beside the bow. Carves nothing; one of these only, laid on the pan.
